evidence.launched: Official Agentic Trading launched May 27 2026 with Robinhood Trading MCP.
evidence.account_read: External agent can read accounts, positions, balances and transactions.
evidence.market_data: Trading MCP exposes Robinhood data sources/tools; Robinhood Agents use dozens of market data sources.
evidence.consumer_data_sources: Robinhood Legend stock data sources include Nasdaq Basic, NYSE BQT, Cboe One, MEMX, IEX, Blue Ocean and OTC Markets.
evidence.nbbo_scope: Robinhood says NBBO is available at time of placing securities trade, not that all streaming market-data fields are consolidated SIP NBBO.
evidence.funding: Agentic setup requires creating and funding a dedicated Agentic Account.

reopen_condition: Only reopen if Robinhood offers Türkiye-resident eligible, unfunded/no-activity read-only MCP with explicitly consolidated SIP/NBBO quote+trade timestamps at permanent $0.
